sentences.en: I can't help taking painkillers when I have a headache.
sentences.zh: 头疼的时候我忍不住要吃止痛药。

sentences.en: I should go to the pharmacy and buy some painkillers.
sentences.zh: 我去药店买点止痛药吧。

sentences.en: Sami killed Layla with a combination of powerful sedatives and painkillers.
sentences.zh: 萨米用强效的镇静剂和止痛药毒死了莱拉。
